title: Version 1.62.0
html:
Version 1.62.0 (🐛 The Debuggification Update! 🐞)

July 15th, 2024

Added:

  • Eel Kelp, a special variant of kelp that provides that extra SHOCK you might need for your builds.
  • Electrified Bamboo, providing a NEON BLACK and NEON WHITE material, on top of the awesome red bark.
  • Looking for something.. conductive? Jenna now has a quest for you in order to find Michael's Copper Axe. Talk to her to learn more!
  • A new gamepass, the Easy Filling Gamepass, allows you to fill up your schematics with 2x less material. This only applies to your property, so if you move those schematics, they may lose their fill state.
  • You can now gift gamepasses to other users! A wonderful feature if you want to treat your friends to something special.

Changes:

  • In order to keep developing the game, we have decided to adjust the prices for some of our gamepasses and other products. Hope you can understand!
  • The product menu now has a new icon. The icon rotates slightly left and right, if this bothers you, there is a setting to disable it
  • There's now new network ownership control for conveyors, improving the speed at which your items go along the conveyors.
  • The lava cave has been remade with meshes, hopefully providing heavy performance improvements. Some things also may be easier / more challenging.
  • The Resource Hub now has a leaderboard showing the most sold materials.
  • The moon now has 7 phases that slowly change as time progresses!
  • The Frequency Clock is now called a Hertz Clock, and the Commander is now called a Chat Commander
  • Boomite's explosion time has been changed from 15 -> 10 minutes.
  • Boomite's refined value has been changed from 70 -> 120, and it's forged value has changed from 100 -> 180.
  • Large Boomite Crystals now have a charge time of 5 -> 3, an explosion radius 80 -> 110, and can now trigger from players and trailers.
  • Large Boomite Crystals now have a cool explosion particle!
  • The awesome youtuber, N8te, now has a creator code! You'll be able to find out how to get that on his channel soon. (or you can just guess the code...)

Fixed:

  • I'm not going to go in depth here, but there is a TON of bug fixes for this patch. Not only that, a TON of map issues have also been fixed. There's still a lot more to be done, but we have a big start!

Version 1.62.1

July 15th, 2024

Fixed:

  • Fixed the supporter gift not giving a chat tag

Version 1.62.2

July 15th, 2024

Added:

  • Added a two minute cooldown to the copper axe quest
